env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^native: 1 failure$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
stdout '^native: 0 failure$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejecterrtrace

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"logos/rt"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("failure")
}

func native() error {
	fail()?
	return nil
}

func main() {
	err := native()
	fmt.Println("native:", len(rt.ErrorTrace()), err)
}
